scope: Structural schema, event consistency and time/weight contract only. No Q_T curve, family-survival fraction, outcome comparison, weight-derived outcome bound or selected window computed.

nodes.id: Unique candidate cell episode, distinct from the dynamic source label.
nodes.label: Source Lineage value. May be retained by a daughter.
nodes.first_frame_last_frame: Inclusive record interval, not automatically an alive interval; renewed at every division.
nodes.parent_nodes_child_nodes: Candidate directed parent/child IDs. Missing daughter slots are not represented as nodes.
nodes.apoptosis_annotation_frames_in_episode: Source death flags mapped into this episode; normally empty or a single frame.
nodes.source_rows: 1-based original workbook rows; repeated ancestor rows must not create extra path weight.
nodes.candidate_roots: Derived component roots, not verified original population founder identities.

schema.edge_boundary_semantics: Observed children begin in boundary_frame; the parent’s division flag is in boundary_frame-1.
schema.event_annotation_keys: Deduplicated [source_label, one_based_frame] pairs in Divisions and Apoptosis.
schema.issues: Includes incomplete daughter observations and positive-Lineage/p53-minus1 contradictions; does not currently include the newly detected simultaneous division/death case, which must be added by the bounds implementation.
schema.baseline_rosters: Keys97,98,99,100,101. Each row contains node, source_label, frame, candidate_roots, post_baseline_issue_kinds and prior_component_issue. Do not select only rows with empty future issue lists.

new_fate_conflict.handling: Fate conflict takes precedence over death and branch classification. Quarantine the affected candidate episode/path as unknown; do not accept either annotation first or invent event ordering.

weight_propagation_contract: Give each chosen baseline cell one unit of prospective tag probability. g starts at0 at that baseline, even if the cell has a long pre-baseline ancestry.
At each documented binary division after baseline, propagate half of incoming weight to each biological daughter: w=2^(-g). A daughter retaining the parent label still increments g.

With two observed children, assign w/2 to each. With one observed child, assign w/2 to it and reserve w/2 for the absent daughter. With no observed child, reserve total w for two absent daughter possibilities.
Never renormalize to observed daughters, uniform terminal rows, selected survivors or the number of extant descendants.
A verified recorded death terminates that tagged branch; it cannot transfer its probability mass to a surviving sibling. Post-apoptosis tracking is not living time.
Once a branch is unknown, keep its tag mass unresolved for later query times; do not invent its hidden generations or split it into multiple independent probability units.

For complete disjoint path-frontier accounting, known-status terminal/frontier mass plus unknown mass must equal1 per baseline node. This is an implementation invariant, not an outcome calculation performed here.

recorded_status_contract.source_supported: The codebook defines division1 and apoptosis1 as events; p53 -1 and Lineage0 as untracked. It does not equate fluorescence positivity or a nonzero lineage label with biological viability.
recorded_status_contract.known_death: Use an unconflicted apoptosis annotation under the frozen frame-event convention, never mere disappearance or a zero lineage label. Stop tag mass at the annotated event even if tracking continues.
recorded_status_contract.observed_not_death_annotated: A positive lineage label plus available measurement and no prior unconflicted death flag can define a recorded present/not-death-annotated state. Calling this biological alive additionally assumes the manual annotation process is correct and complete at the stated temporal resolution.
recorded_status_contract.unknown_branch: No observed sister or daughter is an unresolved branch, not evidence of extinction. Family inclusion can remain uncertain even if the observed sibling dies.
recorded_status_contract.mask_inconsistency: Conservative default: at least the entire affected candidate episode and continuation of the affected tag path are unknown; do not decide that Lineage or p53 wins. A more conservative optional rule can make the whole affected baseline path unknown. Freeze the rule before calculating bounds.
recorded_status_contract.prior_component_issue: An earlier issue in a sibling branch need not invalidate a later observed cell’s future subtree, but original founder clustering remains a separate uncertainty.
recorded_status_contract.scope: Bounds would concern this finite recorded roster under explicit observation assumptions; they are not automatic bounds on population drug persistence or patient outcomes.

time_contract.inverse_for_on_grid_elapsed_time: f=b+2*tau; integer frames only unless an explicit interval convention is frozen.
time_contract.treatment_alignment: Codebook says49h and just before frame98; main methods say50h. First-frame absolute origin remains uncertain. The fixed frame bracket is retained; do not use different founder rosters for different horizons within one baseline scenario.
time_contract.baseline_annotation_boundary: No same-frame apoptosis flags occur among these current rosters, but3,4,6,3,5 baseline cells respectively have a same-frame division annotation. A before/after-division convention at time0 is therefore material and must be frozen.
time_contract.interval_resolution: A flag frame is not an exact continuous-time event instant. Specify event processing at the annotation frame versus the next-frame child boundary, or conservatively leave a one-frame boundary band unknown. Do not silently create living time between death annotation and track disappearance.
time_contract.query_grid_status: Not selected here. Root must freeze common elapsed t and T within support and state how equality at annotated boundaries is handled.

coupled_bounds_requirements: Family inclusion and tag status arise from the same possible completed family; a live tag implies a live family.
Unknown daughter completions must remain consistent across horizons and shared t; do not independently assign incompatible branch fates at each query.
Distinct observed baseline cells may share an earlier root component. Equal baseline-cell weights and equal original-founder weights are different estimands; do not mix them.
Do not filter rosters by future completeness or nondivision. Preserve unknown paths within the same fixed roster across every horizon.
implementation_release_gates: Detect and quarantine simultaneous division/apoptosis before ordinary terminal-fate classification.
Add unknown daughter slots and conserve prospective tag mass.
Freeze baseline event ordering, query frames, endpoint equality, mask-conflict policy, family weighting and any broad observation assumptions.
Retain joint logical constraints on family inclusion and tag status across all query points.
